text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock B after a large gain freed up cash, but the gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position against its future prospects and portfolio role.","Buying more of Stocks A, C, and E increased my exposure, so I should check concentration and risk before adding shares rather than trade simply because cash is available.","My account rose overall despite some down periods, but a short run of returns does not show that my choices predict future prices; I should stay patient and make deliberate decisions."]}
